requestCounts.interpretation: Four timing workers × five fixtures × three operations × (three warmups + seven measured); two diagnostic workers × five fixtures × three operations × three invocations. SQL returned rows and combat group counts are separate from external requests.

method.backendQuantiles: nearest rank ceil(n*q)-1; p50 is fifth and p95 tenth for n=10
method.sessionMedian: fourth ordered wall sample out of seven; mean of two run medians in aggregate
method.memorySummary: median of two ABBA run markers, equivalent to their mean
method.pairs: backend baseline-1/candidate-1 then baseline-2/candidate-2; memory/session baseline-1/candidate-2 then baseline-4/candidate-3
method.adverse: all numeric increases retained; strict joint >1 ms AND >10% in both pairs; no statistical confidence or causality asserted

limitations: Two repetitions per source on one hosted runner; descriptive comparisons, not confidence intervals.
HTTP p95 is maximum of ten measured after-warmup samples and is not startup.
Backend semantic evidence is fixture assertions and settings; complete decoded HTTP equality is not claimed.
Session hash bodies are not archived; recorded route/group hash equality has limited field coverage.
SQL counts represent returned rows, not pages scanned.
RSS is allocator residency; finite retained-heap cycles are not a no-leak proof.
No benchmark/runtime rerun, source changes, causal attribution, or release approval.
